# Neil Baksi

> Product Engineer and MBA candidate. 7+ years building customer-facing digital products in telecom, fintech, and e-commerce.

## About

Neil Baksi is a product engineer with experience at Optus (Singtel) and Limepay (BNPL/fintech), currently an MBA candidate at Melbourne Business School (Kellogg School of Management exchange). He builds full-stack, customer-facing digital products across telecom, fintech, and e-commerce.

## Skills

React, TypeScript, product engineering, front-end architecture, digital product strategy, fintech (BNPL) systems, telecom platforms, e-commerce.

## Projects

- Optus Digital Platform — customer-facing telecom product work at Optus.
- MarketNow — e-commerce project.
- STACK Payments — fintech/payments project.
- Shimmer Bazaar — e-commerce project.
